slides.title: Microsoft Exposes 38TB in AI Data Leak (September
slides.text: Microsoft Exposes 38TB in AI Data Leak    (September 19, 2023) https://www.therundown.ai/p/microsoft-ai-data-leak Key points: The token granted full access to an Azure storage account , not just the intended open AI datasets. Wiz Research discovered computer backups in the data with passwords, keys, and 30,000+ internal Teams messages . Microsoft published a blog reassuring that no customer data was exposed, with no action needed from customers. Why it matters: Reminder  - tighten your AI guardrails More data - more security needed (AI - lots of data)

slides.title: Local Private Data + Embedding + VectorDB +
slides.text: Local Private Data + Embedding + VectorDB + LLM LLaMa 2 was open-sourced on July 18th, 2023 In 2 months ~1,000 variations of LLaMa were created at HuggingFace.co - improving the model, making it smaller. You can now have performance at ChatGPT-3.5 level with local open-source model running on relatively inexpensive hardware Local Components: File storage VectorDB Embedding Model LLM LangChain framework Front-end application RAG = Retrieval Augmented Generation System generates response based in the prompt with user query augmented with text retrieved from local vectorDB.
